project_type: Laravel 11 full-stack tutor platform (Blade views + Alpine.js frontend, M-Pesa payments)
build_system: Laravel Artisan + npm (Vite); artisan migrate for DB setup
test_framework: PHPUnit (standard Laravel); no tests required for this feature per spec
build_command: npm run build && php artisan migrate
verification_instructions: After migrations: php artisan tinker; verify tables exist: DB::table('group_session_suggestions')->getColumns(). After controller: php artisan route:list | grep suggestion. After integration: visit /group-sessions/{id} in browser and verify poll widget renders. Admin: visit /admin/group-sessions/suggestions.
environment_constraints: Schema::hasColumn() guards used in migrations and models for backwards compatibility. ExaminerClinic reuses examiner_clinics table with is_group_session boolean. No new npm/composer dependencies allowed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: defensive DB checks, timestamps on all models, relationships clearly named, validation in controller, Blade partials for reusable views, Alpine.js for frontend (not Livewire). Use project CSS variables (--ink, --trust-blue, --coral, --gold, --mint) and fonts (Fraunces serif, DM Sans).
key_patterns: Defensive column checks via Schema::hasColumn() used throughout codebase. Models use fillable + casts. Controllers handle guests gracefully (nullable auth). Admin views follow DataTables pattern. Routes grouped by middleware (public, auth, admin). Blade partials for shared UI.
directory_structure: app/Models: Eloquent models. app/Http/Controllers: route handlers. database/migrations: schema. resources/views/pages: public/user views. resources/views/pages/admin: admin views. resources/views/partials: reusable Blade snippets. routes/web.php: all routes.
